2.88.28
Chart.Filters
In RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01, the Chart.Filters element specifies a collection of Filter instances
for a Chart. In RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01, the Chart.Filters element specifies a
set of filters for a Chart. The Chart.Filters element is optional. This element is of type Filters.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.Filters element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.Filters element.
 <xsd:element name="Filters" type="FiltersType" minOccurs="0" />
